title: Bernoulli average concentration
statement: Let $p\in[0,1]$, let $\varepsilon>0$, and let $0<\delta\le 1$. If $k$ is a natural number satisfying $\log(2/\delta)/(2\varepsilon^2)\le k$, then under the product distribution of $k$ independent Bernoulli-$p$ bits, the probability that the absolute difference between the fraction of successes and $p$ exceeds $\varepsilon$ is at most $\delta$.
